reference.title: Scenario 9: in-line image in a task topic
reference.shortdesc: Consider an "Add File" chapter in a "User Guide" document where you want an inline

section.p: Consider an "Add File" chapter in a "User Guide" document where you want an inline image in the procedure. You want to show the add file icon in the procedure itself using only the image tag and setting the @placement attribute to inline.
section.note: Do not wrap the <image> in a <fig> tag.
section.codeblock:
Add a file to the project. Open the application. Click the Add File icon.

The Add File pop-up dialog box appears.

…

The file is added to the project.
section.p: Result: Use <image placement="inline"> inside <cmd> to embed small icons or inline screenshots that appear in line with command text.
